positions.as_written: Expect a meniscectomised knee to absorb fast loads less well, and advise on activity accordingly.
Read subchondral sclerosis as evidence of concentrated load and look for its cause.
Treat accelerometry as a proxy for loading rate rather than a measurement of it.
Treat shock absorption as the mechanical account of activity advice.
